name: Twilight Grove
summary: At Duskwood's center, Twilight Grove shelters lush Kalimdor flora beneath its great tree. A moonwell and ancient night elf architecture surround a massive emerald gateway to the Emerald Dream.

sections.title: A Sanctuary in the Gloom
sections.body:
Behind steep crater ridges in Duskwood's heart, Twilight Grove seems utterly alien to the Eastern Kingdoms. Night elf gazebos and green meadows surround a serene moonwell. An unnamed great tree towers over the gloomy canopy.

The tree draws vigor from the Emerald Dream into the waking world. So the crater thrives beneath Duskwood's eternal gloom.

sections.title: The Emerald Gateway
sections.body:
At the great tree's base stands a massive stone portal, one of four known gateways linking the physical realm directly to the Emerald Dream. Ysera's green dragonflight traditionally watches over this gateway. Dark whispers say malevolent forces have begun twisting the tranquil realm beyond.

The gateway remains largely silent. Yet its emerald swirl warns that cosmic corruption may spill into Duskwood from paths deeper than the Scourge or the local worgen.

faq.q: Why is there night elf architecture in Duskwood?
faq.answer: Night elf hands raised the gazebos and moonwell around the grove's great tree and its gateway to the Emerald Dream. Few know when or how they came to stand so far from Kalimdor.

faq.q: What is the giant glowing green portal?
faq.answer: It is a Great Tree portal leading directly into the Emerald Dream, the primordial blueprint of Azeroth overseen by the green dragonflight. Three similar portals stand in Ashenvale, Feralas, and the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Who watches over the grove today?
faq.answer: Lieutenants of Ysera's green dragonflight have guarded the sanctuary. Travelers often find it empty, but growing disturbances within the Emerald Dream threaten to send corrupted guardians through the portal into the mortal world.

faq.q: Why doesn't the Twilight Grove look dead like the rest of Duskwood?
faq.answer: The great tree channels the Emerald Dream's pure, untamed life energy. Its steady flow protects the inner basin from the supernatural curse and blight choking the surrounding woods.

angles.text: As a druid exploring the Eastern Kingdoms, you find a rare oasis of home here, with an active moonwell and a direct link to the ancestral dreamways.
For you, a secluded moonwell and traditional gazebos so far from Kalimdor recall your people's ancient duty to heal Azeroth's wounds.
